summary: Iteration 103: SAAD Commission System (Mollie) + Glycemia V2 Algorithm + BLE auto-detect testing completed. All 23 backend tests pass. Fixed minor API inconsistency in /api/glycemia/trend endpoint.

minor.issue: Missing 'count' field in response when history < 2 entries

critical_code_review_comments: SAAD Commission: POST /api/saad/onboarding correctly registers SAAD with commission_type (monthly/oneshot)
SAAD Status: GET /api/saad/status/{saad_id} returns registered=true with total_earned, total_pending, commissions_count
SAAD Legacy Routes: /api/saad/stripe-onboarding and /api/saad/stripe-status/{id} correctly redirect to new endpoints
Glycemia V2: Returns algorithm_version='v2', estimated_glycemia in g/L, 5 zones (normal, normal_high, vigilance, pre_alert, alert)
Glycemia V2: Calibration quality (none/low/medium/high) based on calibration count
Glycemia V2: Factors include name, score, weight, impact for transparency
Contract Activation: _activate_contract correctly calls _process_saad_commission for care plans (line 492)
BLE Auto-detect: bracelet-connect.tsx uses service UUIDs for device detection, not name filtering (V6_NAME_PREFIXES is empty)
seed_data_creation: Created test SAAD accounts for commission testing, added glycemia calibrations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 103 verified: (1) SAAD onboarding with monthly/oneshot commission_type, (2) SAAD status returns earnings/pending totals, (3) Legacy stripe routes redirect properly, (4) Mollie commission webhook handles empty/unknown payment IDs, (5) Admin SAAD commissions endpoint returns list with totals, (6) Glycemia V2 returns algorithm_version=v2 with estimated_glycemia in g/L, (7) 5-zone system implemented, (8) Calibration with context saves sensor_snapshot, (9) Calibrations history endpoint works, (10) Trend endpoint returns direction, (11) V6 bracelet data used in glycemia estimation, (12) bracelet-connect.tsx loads correctly with auto-detect by services.
